stabilityRedis.label: Stability Redistribution

competenceTrust.label: Competence Trust
competenceTrust.description: The solution is the asset. Rigor and competence are rewarded.

growthRisk.label: Growth Risk
growthRisk.description: Growth is the asset. Speed, scalability, and capital are rewarded.

hybridTransition.label: Hybrid Transition
hybridTransition.description: Multiple logics coexist. Navigate contradictions and rapid changes.

resourceExtraction.label: Resource Extraction
resourceExtraction.description: Natural resources fund the system. Proximity to the flow matters most.

countries.subtitle: Deep analysis of national systems. Understand what each country really rewards, the risks, and your strategic options.

cameroon.name: Cameroon
cameroon.ruleOfGold: Never solve a visible problem. Never become indispensable. Never centralize.

pyramid.realAsset: The problem itself — dysfunction is profitable

whoLoses: The young and ambitious without networks

plan30Days: Identify one exportable skill to develop
plan12Months: Create first offshore account if possible
playbook.planB: Focus on French-speaking destinations with easier visa access (Morocco, Senegal, France, Canada-Quebec). Build digital skills for remote work.

france.name: France
france.ruleOfGold: The system protects stability, not explosion. Play the long game within the rules.
whoWins: Those who master the system rules
Those with right diplomas and networks

playbook.planB: EU mobility is your advantage. Consider Portugal, Spain, or Netherlands for lower friction. Switzerland for higher ambition. Keep French benefits while building elsewhere.

switzerland.name: Switzerland
switzerland.ruleOfGold: Excellence + rules + reputation = security. No shortcuts, no approximations.

pyramid.base: Citizens invested in maintaining the system

playbook.planB: Other COMPETENCE_TRUST systems: Germany, Netherlands, Austria, Singapore. Build credentials that transfer across these systems.

usa.name: United States
usa.ruleOfGold: Win fast, secure gains, diversify. The system rewards velocity, not stability.
whoLoses: Those relying on social safety net

playbook.planB: Consider Canada for stability with growth, Portugal for EU access, Dubai for tax optimization. Keep US income while building options.

germany.name: Germany
germany.ruleOfGold: Precision, process, and patience. The system rewards those who master the rules.

pyramid.base: Taxpayers supporting the social market economy

playbook.planB: Similar systems: Austria, Switzerland, Netherlands. German qualifications are highly transferable in EU.

uae.name: United Arab Emirates
uae.ruleOfGold: Be useful to power, stay discreet, never go local. Your gains are yours as long as you follow the rules.

pyramid.top: Ruling families and their inner circles
pyramid.institutions: State structures serving the royal vision
pyramid.realAsset: Access to power and usefulness to the system

whoWins: Those who understand the red lines
whoLoses: Those who forget they are guests

do: Maintain low profile on sensitive topics
plan30Days: Open local and international bank accounts
Identify red lines not to cross
playbook.planB: Options to consider: Portugal or Spain for EU, Singapore for Asia, Mauritius for favorable taxation with residence.

nigeria.name: Nigeria
nigeria.ruleOfGold: Hustle or disappear. The system rewards agility, not conformity.

pyramid.institutions: Weak state with pockets of competence

dont: Depend on a single income source
playbook.planB: Ghana for regional stability, UK or Canada for established diaspora, Dubai for business. Develop tech skills for global mobility.

singapore.name: Singapore
singapore.ruleOfGold: Excellence + conformity + added value = permission to stay. No room for mediocrity.

do: Respect all rules to the letter
playbook.planB: Hong Kong for finance, Malaysia MM2H for cost of living, Australia for citizenship. Build transferable Asia-Pacific skills.

portugal.name: Portugal
portugal.ruleOfGold: Patience and quality of life. The system offers EU access in exchange for time and capital.

pyramid.realAsset: EU access and quality of life

whoWins: Those with capital or passive income
Digital nomads with strong currency income

do: Take advantage of NHR tax regime if eligible
playbook.planB: Spain for more economic opportunities, Malta for taxation, France for French speakers. Portuguese passport opens all of EU.

morocco.name: Morocco
morocco.ruleOfGold: Respect the codes, build relationships, stay discreet about power.

pyramid.top: Monarchy and circles close to power

whoLoses: Those who openly challenge the system

playbook.planB: France for French-speaking diaspora, Spain for proximity, UAE for business. Morocco can be an Africa hub.

canada.name: Canada
canada.ruleOfGold: Immigrate by the rules, integrate patiently, build for the long term.
whoWins: Those who follow the process patiently
Those who integrate into local culture
whoLoses: Those who don't adapt to climate

playbook.planB: USA for opportunities (if visa possible), Australia for similar climate, UK for Commonwealth ties.

brazil.name: Brazil
brazil.ruleOfGold: Jeitinho and relationships. The formal system exists, but the real game is informal.

pyramid.realAsset: Network and ability to navigate the system

whoWins: Those with good network (QI = Quem Indica)
whoLoses: Those who don't adapt to culture

playbook.planB: Portugal for EU (common language), Argentina for region, USA for opportunities. Brazil can be a Latin America hub.

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.ruleOfGold: Competence + network + perseverance. The system is open but competitive.

dont: Depend on healthcare system without backup
playbook.planB: Ireland for EU access + English-speaking, USA for opportunities, Canada for similar lifestyle. UK remains global financial hub.

japan.name: Japan
japan.ruleOfGold: Conformity, patience, and mastery. The system rewards those who truly integrate.

playbook.planB: Singapore for English-speaking Asia, South Korea for similar culture, Taiwan for more relaxed environment. Japan requires total commitment.

australia.name: Australia
australia.ruleOfGold: Skills + points = access. The system is meritocratic but selective.
whoWins: Those who pass the points system
Those who adapt to Australian lifestyle
whoLoses: Those without skills on the list

do: Target skills on the skills list
playbook.planB: New Zealand for easier access, Canada for similar system, Singapore for Asia-Pacific. Australia offers excellent quality of life.
Plan B

china.name: China
china.ruleOfGold: Align publicly with the Party, build privately. Never become a political symbol.

pyramid.institutions: State apparatus mixing control and market
pyramid.gatekeepers: Party connections, guanxi networks, regulatory approvals

whoWins: Those who read political winds correctly
whoLoses: Those growing too fast too visibly

do: Invest in skills that transfer globally
playbook.planB: Singapore, Japan, or Taiwan for similar cultures. Portugal, Canada for different environments. Keep skills exportable and assets diversified.

russia.name: Russia
russia.ruleOfGold: Never challenge power publicly. The state giveth and the state taketh away.

pyramid.realAsset: Loyalty to power and useful invisibility

whoWins: Those close to power without threatening it

dont: Build business dependent on single sector
playbook.planB: Georgia, Armenia, Serbia for easier entry. EU countries for longer-term. Keep passport valid, skills current, assets mobile.

brazil.name: Brazil
brazil.ruleOfGold: Navigate the jeitinho - flexibility, networks, and patience beat formal rules.

pyramid.top: Political class and major business families
pyramid.institutions: Complex bureaucracy mixing formal and informal
pyramid.base: Workers in formal and informal economies

dont: Expect things to work like home country
playbook.planB: Portugal for language/culture similarity. Other Latin American countries. US or EU with right visa. Keep options open.

norway.name: Norway
norway.ruleOfGold: The collective comes first. Excellence is good but never above the group.

plan30Days: Research job market in your field
playbook.planB: Other Nordic countries, Netherlands, Germany for similar stability. Lower cost options in Southern Europe with EU mobility.

qatar.name: Qatar
qatar.ruleOfGold: Be useful, stay quiet, plan your exit. You are a guest with an expiration date.

pyramid.top: Al Thani royal family and close circles
pyramid.institutions: State structures serving vision and stability
pyramid.realAsset: Usefulness to state projects and discretion

playbook.planB: UAE for similar region. Singapore for Asia. Portugal, Malta for EU access. Have multiple options ready.

venezuela.name: Venezuela
venezuela.ruleOfGold: Survive, stay invisible, prepare your exit. The system rewards only those at the very top.

playbook.planB: Colombia, Peru, Chile for proximity. Spain for cultural ties. US with right visa. Move as soon as possible.

saudiArabia.name: Saudi Arabia
saudiArabia.ruleOfGold: Serve the vision, respect the values, know your place. High rewards for the useful, high risks for the visible.

playbook.planB: UAE, Bahrain for regional options. Portugal, Malta for EU. Canada, Australia for permanent options. Plan carefully.

india.name: India
india.ruleOfGold: Navigate the paradox of ancient systems and explosive growth. Relationships and resilience beat pure credentials.

pyramid.institutions: Dense bureaucracy mixing colonial legacy and digital future
pyramid.valueCreators: Entrepreneurs in formal and informal sectors

playbook.planB: UAE, Singapore for nearby options. US, UK, Canada for developed markets. Keep skills exportable.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.ruleOfGold: Ride the volatility if you can, hedge if you must. Political winds change fast.

pyramid.top: Presidential circle and aligned business groups

do: Earn in hard currency if possible
playbook.planB: EU countries via citizenship programs. Georgia, Serbia for easy entry. UAE for regional option. Keep assets mobile.

lottery.label: The Shortcut Seeker
lottery.description: You want an immediate exit, a break from your current situation, a shortcut.
lottery.workRelation: Low engagement with long-term work — effort feels pointless if slow.
lottery.riskRelation: Often high but poorly controlled — unconscious risk-taking.
lottery.whatWorks: Strict budgeting if gambling, parallel Plan B with stable income and useful skills.
lottery.trap: Waiting for 'the sign', going into debt, believing opportunity replaces strategy.

comfort.label: Comfort & Zero Stress
comfort.description: You seek tranquility, routine, and psychological security.
comfort.workRelation: You want structure, clear expectations, defined framework.
comfort.whatWorks: Stability, slow but certain progression, automatic savings, predictable job.
comfort.trap: Getting bored, fading out, then exploding after a few years.

builder.label: Patient Builder
builder.description: You want wealth + pride + the feeling of having earned it.
builder.workRelation: Ready to work, but effort must make sense and actually pay off.
builder.whatWorks: Simple business, rare skills, discipline, long-term investing.
builder.trap: Going too complex too early, scattering, inventing sophisticated strategies before having the basics.

safeWealth.label: Safe Wealth Builder
safeWealth.description: You want high income with maximum security.
safeWealth.workRelation: OK with working, but not with putting yourself at risk.
safeWealth.whatWorks: Increase income via rare skills, secure via diversification, insurance, long-term strategy.
safeWealth.trap: Internal contradiction (wanting jackpot without trade-offs) → stagnation.

nomad.label: Global Nomad
nomad.description: You seek geographic freedom and autonomy.
nomad.workRelation: You want to work from anywhere.
nomad.whatWorks: Remote jobs, income in strong currency, understanding of visas, rules, and logistics.

purpose.label: Purpose-Driven
purpose.riskRelation: Often moderate, but emotion can push you to forget yourself.
purpose.whatWorks: Useful jobs + clear limits + anti-burnout system + self-care + protection framework.
purpose.trap: Sacrificing yourself, burning out, confusing value with suffering.

status.label: Status Seeker
status.description: You seek recognition, respect, social identity.
status.riskRelation: Moderate to high depending on ego and competition.
status.whatWorks: Excellence, selectivity, network, storytelling, career strategy.
status.trap: Toxic comparison, performance anxiety, fragile identity if status drops.

recovery.label: Recovery & Rebuilding
recovery.description: You seek security, control, repair, emotional stability, reconstruction.
recovery.workRelation: Need for mastery, sometimes fear of instability.
recovery.riskRelation: Low at first, then increases as security returns.
recovery.whatWorks: Stabilize first (income, framework, routine), then progressive ramp-up, clear plan, realistic goals.
recovery.trap: Judging yourself, trying to catch up 10 years in 6 months, exhausting yourself.
